10k.note: 10-K describes ultra-sensitive biomarker detection platform (Simoa) and spatial biology instruments; no proprietary therapeutic pipeline.

website.note: Corporate site lists instruments (HD-X, SR-X, SP-X, PhenoCycler-Fusion 2.0, PhenoImager HT 2.0, PhenoImager Fusion), assay kits, and Lucent Diagnostics LDTs (LucentAD p-Tau 217, Simoa NfL). No drug pipeline page exists.

ctgov.note: Quanterix is not a clinical-trial sponsor; its assays appear in third-party studies as biomarker readouts.

platforms.name: Simoa
platforms.category: Single Molecule Array (digital immunoassay) instruments and assays

tests.name: LucentAD
tests.intended_use: blood-based aid in Alzheimer's disease detection

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Quanterix is a diagnostics / life-science tools company (ultra-sensitive Simoa biomarker immunoassays plus spatial-biology instruments from the Akoya acquisition) and a CLIA laboratory operator (Lucent Diagnostics LDTs). It does not develop therapeutic drugs and is not the sponsor of any P1/P2/P3 interventional clinical trials. Approved/marketed products are listed under commercial_product.
